name: PNB RuPay Select Optima Debit Card
description: PNB RuPay Select Optima Debit Card is a PNB RUPAY SELECT OPTIMA from Punjab National Bank. International usage; ATM limit Rs. 150,000/day, PoS/eCom limit Rs. 500,000/day. NCMC offline transit enabled. Valid 7 years.
tagline: RuPay Select debit card from PNB — international usage with NCMC transit.
